name: Floating Glass River Market
description: A bustling market floating on a river of liquid glass, where stalls drift on translucent waves, selling holographic fruits that change color with each touch.
prompt: A lively floating market on a shimmering glass river, stalls made of clear crystal, glowing holographic fruits floating near stalls, vibrant pastel colors, gentle reflections, daylight with soft shadows, photorealistic, no written signs, bustling yet whimsical atmosphere.
caption: Shop among the clouds on a river of glass—every fruit glows with a secret rainbow inside.
